title: Funds Availability and Transaction Limits on Personal Checking
content:
**Availability.** A deposit posts to the Personal Checking ledger on the business day its funds become available, so the ledger balance is also the available balance. Cash, direct deposits, incoming automated credits, incoming wires, person-to-person receipts and internal transfers post on the business day received. A deposited check posts on the next business day, except that while the account has been open fewer than the tier's new-account period of calendar days a deposited check posts on the business day after deposit that the tier names.

**Mobile deposit.** A mobile deposit is accepted only when it keeps the day's mobile deposits within the tier's daily setting and the rolling 30 calendar days within the tier's 30-day setting. An over-limit mobile deposit is rejected and never posts.

**Debits.** Debits are authorized only within the tier's daily settings, counted per calendar day in Eastern Time: cash at cash machines within the tier's daily cash setting, debit card purchases within the tier's daily purchase setting, and person-to-person payments within the tier's daily sending setting and, measured over the rolling 30 calendar days, within the tier's 30-day sending setting. An authorization beyond a setting is declined and never posts.

**Other conditions.** Paper checks can be paid only on a tier on which check writing is available. Requests to raise a limit temporarily are outside this basis. Deposits are accepted on restricted and dormant accounts but not on closed or charged-off accounts.

**Points of judgement.** The daily and the rolling settings are read together, so a payment inside the day's setting is still declined where it would carry the rolling 30 calendar days past the 30-day setting. A rejected mobile deposit leaves no entry at all, so it neither raises the ledger balance nor counts toward either setting.
